result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A sets each status as a distinct badge (outline, yellow fill, black fill) with an icon and bold text, and uses heavy, high-contrast figures, so it should read well in bright sun without relying on colour. B separates statuses mainly by orange, red and green text at the same weight, which is weaker in sunlight. B's phone number is large and clear, but A's is cut off in the screenshot, so it can't be checked and was scored low. Neither screenshot shows the font stack, so item 4 is a guess from how the system sans renders. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both use heavy system sans, large tabular-looking times and readable status words. B's status badges (outlined, tinted, inverted for cancelled) give a stronger non-colour difference than A's same-weight coloured labels with icons. However, B's phone number is cut off in the render and can't be checked, while A shows it large, high-contrast, in a tappable block with clear digits.
